card.name: Inside pyrotechnic and pertechnetate words
card.fires_on: The word piece just before "chn" in "pyrotechny/pyrotechnic" ("rote") and in "pertechnetate" ("erte"). It fires on the sodium pertechnetate Tc 99m label wording and on strontium's pyrotechnic use.

modes.label: Pyrotechnics
modes.description: The middle piece "rote" of pyrotechny or pyrotechnic in a description of strontium.

card.writes: It pushes the next piece toward "techn" and related technical words, which fits the "chn" that comes next in these words.
